job.name: ig19_host_a
job.meaning: мужчина ~52, короткие волосы с проседью, аккуратная щетина, чёрный пиджак поверх чёрной футболки, тёплая студия с арками
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm confident Russian man about 52 with short salt-and-pepper hair and a neat grey stubble, a black unstructured blazer over a black t-shirt. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, he sits relaxed, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm at the side of the frame near his chest (never covering the mouth), face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, sincere thoughtful expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a warm podcast studio with soft beige arched wall niches and warm hidden lighting, blurred, golden-brown tones.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.

attempts.issue: Remove the microphone and gesturing hand, and keep mouth in neutral resting position
